title: ABB/SGP for [MTR4]
description: ABB-SGP train from Metro İstanbul M1A and M1B Light Metro line
body:
# Introduction
This resource pack adds the ABB-SGP light metro train sets, currently operating on the M1A and M1B lines in Istanbul, to the Minecraft Transit Railway (MTR) mod.

For the most compatible sound behavior, it is recommended to configure the train sound pitch settings as follows:
- Acceleration: 0.7 - 1.1
- Deceleration: 1.1 - 1.5
